name: Velvet Widow
description: A patient broodmother with red velvet joints. It uses two short bites to hold prey while its young drag the web closed.

abilities.description: Makes 2 strikes per response. Plating and retaliation apply to each strike.
Applies 2 poison once per response only if a strike damages player health.
